mapper.sql: FROM branch b LEFT JOIN partner p ON b.p_idx = p.p_idx

b.b_active = 1
AND ( b.b_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.b_address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.b_description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM space s WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND s.s_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) )
AND b.b_address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{region}, '%')
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM space s WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND CAST(s.s_max_capacity AS UNSIGNED) >= #{capacity} )
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space s JOIN facilities f ON s.s_idx = f.s_idx WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND f.f_parking = 1) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space s JOIN facilities f ON s.s_idx = f.s_idx WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND f.f_hours24 = 1) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space s JOIN facilities f ON s.s_idx = f.s_idx WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND f.f_pet = 1) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space s JOIN facilities f ON s.s_idx = f.s_idx WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND (f.f_desk = 1 OR f.f_wifi = 1)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space s JOIN facilities f ON s.s_idx = f.s_idx WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND (f.f_cafe = 1 OR f.f_coffee = 1)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space s JOIN facilities f ON s.s_idx = f.s_idx WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND (f.f_fax = 1 OR f.f_printer = 1)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space s JOIN facilities f ON s.s_idx = f.s_idx WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND (f.f_storage = 1 OR f.f_locker = 1))
AND (6371 * acos(cos(radians(#{lat})) * cos(radians(b.b_latitude)) * cos(radians(b.b_altitude) - radians(#{lng})) + sin(radians(#{lat})) * sin(radians(b.b_latitude)))) < 20
mapper.select:
SELECT b.b_idx, b.p_idx, b.b_name, b.b_description, b.b_file, b.b_address, b.b_latitude, b.b_altitude, b.b_phone, b.b_sns, b.b_hours, b.b_notice, b.b_refund_policy, p.p_name
WHERE b.b_active = 1 ORDER BY b.b_idx ASC

SELECT b.b_idx, b.p_idx, b.b_name, b.b_description, b.b_file, b.b_address, b.b_latitude, b.b_altitude, b.b_phone, b.b_sns, b.b_hours, b.b_notice, b.b_refund_policy, p.p_name
WHERE b.b_idx = #{brnIdx}
SELECT b_idx, b_name, b_address, b_description, b_latitude, b_altitude, b_phone, b_file, b_active FROM branch WHERE b_active = 1

SELECT b.b_idx, b.p_idx, b.b_name, b.b_description, b.b_file, b.b_address, b.b_latitude, b.b_altitude, b.b_phone, b.b_sns, b.b_hours, b.b_notice, b.b_refund_policy, p.p_name
JOIN space s ON s.b_idx = b.b_idx WHERE s.s_idx = #{sIdx}
